name: apify-dataset
description: Reads Apify dataset items and dataset metadata (item_collection, dataset_collection, dataset) through the Apify API v2. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external Apify Dataset API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
